title: I Tried Dropshipping For 14 Days (Realistic Results)
summary: Two-week organic dropshipping challenge: copies a competitor's product and videos, goes viral mostly to the wrong demographic, ends with a modest profit; sells a mentorship.

assertions.quote: I've made multiple six figures in profit with organic drop shipping. I've got over a billion views with my own two hands

verdicts.note: Organic virality does generate sales for some, but it is unpredictable and conversion is low.

assertions.quote: I got a video with a million views and got zero sales.

verdicts.note: Views from regions or audiences unlikely to buy do not convert, as ad-targeting data shows.

assertions.quote: once you know how to go viral and go viral consistently, money just falls out of thin air

verdicts.note: Even the source's own test needed daily filming for a week and yielded modest profit.

assertions.quote: your only job is to spot one of those products, steal it, and run it for yourself
like all these results right here of all our inner circle students
$869 in profit is not bad whatsoever

verdicts.note: Published first-hand tests typically report modest profits, but the sample is self-selected.

assertions.quote: All I was doing was reposting my old viral videos.

verdicts.note: Reposting can keep some views, but platforms de-rank duplicates and sales decline.
